entries.title: Cuphead
entries.definitive_edition: Windows version with The Delicious Last Course DLC

primary.version: Cuphead with The Delicious Last Course DLC
primary.why: Cuphead released on Windows and Xbox One, then macOS, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, and a limited Tesla Arcade version. Windows is the best archive route because it has the highest capture/settings flexibility, while The Delicious Last Course is available on Steam/GOG alongside console platforms.
primary.how_to_play: Use Cuphead on Windows through Steam or GOG with The Delicious Last Course installed. Use Tesla Arcade only as a novelty comparison because the sourced Tesla release only included limited content.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC route with full game and DLC, best capture/settings flexibility.
